scope: Exploratory development runs, separate from final heldout verification and production campaign call counts.

contract.note: Coordinated before any fault screening; primary preserves original project requirement.

legacy_screening_limit: The first two exploratory fault screens predate the per-row source-fingerprint helper. They retain exact requests and reported metrics, not complete routing traces. Definitive selected claims require the final source-complete proof/replay packets.

baseline_exclusion.reason: Constant-flow baseline violates the100m³ primary requirement under the supplied design storm.

original_predeclaration.rationale: Avoid material modeled surface flooding; 1 cubic metre permits numerical and negligible hydraulic artifacts. This is an analytical benchmark contract, not an operator regulation.
original_predeclaration.interaction_rule: Nominal and each individual fault must meet the fixed primary contract; the combined faults must violate it. Preserve continuous metrics and failed screens.
original_predeclaration.policy_selection: Favor Pareto improvements of flood, downstream peak/excess, terminal storage; freeze parameters before independent held-out evaluation. Never relabel a tradeoff as safe.
original_predeclaration.exclusion: No real-world safety, field-protection or globally optimal controller claim. Screening data is development data.
original_predeclaration.prior_observations: Only fault-free baseline runs observed before this persisted timestamp; fixed 1 m³ contract already selected before those baselines.
original_predeclaration.contract_alignment: Before any fault screening, coordinated with independent verifier to retain project preexisting 100 m³ primary requirement. Initial stricter 1 m³ proposal remains secondary; no threshold chosen using joint outcomes.
